author: Tabletop Minions
description:
It's really cold here - and I wanted to test what would happen if I used a spraycan to prime in the freezing cold - AND keep it outside to dry!

MiniWargaming terrain: https://forge.miniwargaming.com

The sprays I used: https://www.amazon.com/shop/tabletopminions/list/16X66NHBWN5V7?ref_=cm_sw_r_cp_ud_aip_sf_list_spv_ofs_mixed_d_4PCKTYH5QGMHK3SP7AZ0

Vince Venturella and I made ANOTHER game! Check out Reign in Iron - miniatures-agnostic robots vs. demons skirmish combat at http://www.reigninirongame.com
